entries.def:
θροέω, -ῶ
(θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX: Sng.5.4 (הָמָה * ;] 
in cl., 
__1. to cry aloud, make an outcry. 
__2. to utter aloud. 
__3. In NT (and LXX), pass., to be troubled, as by an alarm: Mat.24.6, Mrk.13.7, Luk.24.37 (WH, mg.), 2Th.2.2 (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 126).†
(AS)

θρόμβος, -ου, ὁ
(τρέφω, in primary sense to thicken), 
a lump, a clot of blood (DCG, ii, 685b): αἵματος, Luk.22.44 (WH, R, mg. omit the passage, see WH, App., 64 ff.).†
(AS)

θρόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כִּסֵּא, Exo.11.5, al. ;] 
in Hom., a seat, chair. Later, a throne, chair of state, seat of authority; of kings: metaphorically, of God, Mat.5.34, Act.7.49" (LXX), Rev.1.4, al.; by meton., for kingly power, sovereignty, Luk.1.32, 52, Act.2.30; for an angelic hierarchy, Col.1.16 of Christ, Mat.19.28, Rev.3.21, al.; of Satan, Rev.2.13 τ. θηρίου, Rev.16.10 of the Apostles, Mat.19.28,…

Θυάτειρα, -ων, τά
(-ας, ἡ, Rev.1.11 L; cf. WH, App., 156) 
Thyatira, a city of Lydia: Act.16.14, Rev.1.11; 2.18, 24.†
(AS)

θυγάτριον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of θυγάτηρ), 
a little daughter, a term of endearment used in late Gk. (cf. B1., § 27, 4): Mrk.5.23; 7.25.†
(AS)

θύελλα, -ης, ἡ
(θύω), [in LXX Deu.4.11; 5.22 (עֲרָפֶל), Exo.10.22 * ;] (poët. in cl.), 
a hurricane, cyclone, whirlwind: Heb.12.18.†
SYN.: λαίλαψ (which see) (AS)

θύινος (usually θύϊνος, as Rec.), -η, -ον 
(θυία, θύα, an African aromatic tree, with ornamentally veined wood of varying colour, = Lat. citrinus), [in Sm.: 1Ki.10.11 (אַלְמֻגִּים)* ;] 
thyme: ξύλον, Rev.18.12 (Diosc.).†
(AS)

θυμίαμα, -τος, τό
(θυμιάω), [in LXX chiefly for קְטֹרֶת ;] 
fragrant stuff for burning, incense: ἡ ὥρα τοῦ θ., Luk.1.10 θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θ. (Exo.30.27, al.), Luk.1.11; pl., Rev.5.8; 8.3-4; 18.13.†
(AS)

θυμιατήριον, -ου, τό
(θυμιάω), [in LXX: 2Ch.26.19, Ezk.8.11 (קְטֹרֶת), 4Ma.7.11 * ;] 
__1. as in cl. (Hdt., iv, 162; Thuc., vi, 46) and LXX, a censer: Heb.9.4 (but see infr., and cf. Westc., in l). 
__2. As in Philo., rer. div., § 46, FlJ, Ant., iv, 2, 4, al., the altar of incense: He, l.with (but see supr. and cf. MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)
